verdict.rationale: Hyperbrowser documents AI-driven browser agents and AI extraction of structured data from web pages. None of that is the product generating insights or suggestions from the user's own data inside the product. Extraction and agent automation are adjacent capabilities, and the evidence shows no in-product analytics or suggestion feature over user data such as sessions, recordings or usage.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can get AI-generated insights and suggestions from my data inside the product
